es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: “Un pequeño cuidador de LibGen”: editoriales musicales demandan a los fundadores de Anthropic por torrenting
items.summary: Anthropic y sus cofundadores son demandados por Sony Music, Warner Chappell y otras grandes editoriales por descargar en masa libros piratas de LibGen y Pirate Library Mirror, alegando que la misma actividad que originó un acuerdo de 1,5 mil millones también violó sus obras musicales.

items.title: When It Rains, It Pours: SOCAN Sues Suno for Allegedly ‘Engaging in Rampant Copyright Infringement on a Massive Scale’
items.summary: When it rains, it pours: SOCAN has filed a Suno copyright lawsuit of its own, accusing the platform of unlawfully training on protected works and then generating infringing outputs. items.title: Suno Faces Yet Another Multimillion-Dollar Copyright Lawsuit — This Time from Latin and Regional Mexican Label Gerencia
items.summary: Another day, another high-stakes copyright lawsuit against Suno – this time from Latin label and publisher Gerencia 360, which is accusing the AI music platform of infringing on hundreds of compositions and recordings. Founded by Luis del Villar 13 years back, Burbank-headquartered Gerencia submitted its straightforwar…

items.title: Latest Suno lawsuit accuses AI company of violating the publicity rights of musicians rather than infringing their copyrights
items.summary: Suno is facing another lawsuit from the music industry. But this time it’s not a copyright lawsuit. A group of musicians claim Suno has violated their US publicity rights by “encoding musicians’ identities into its AI model” and then “exploiting those identities by publicly using musicians’ names”

items.title: The Sony and Warner music publishers finally get round to suing Anthropic
items.summary: The Sony and Warner music publishing companies are the latest publishers to sue AI firm Anthropic for copyright infringement. They also name Anthropic founders Ben Mann and Dario Amodei as defendants, arguing they were personally involved in the illegal downloading of pirated sheet music and lyrics

items.title: Donald Trump’s DoJ says OpenAI should be able to do whatever it wants with copyright protected works
items.summary: The US Department Of Justice has intervened in a legal battle between the New York Times and OpenAI, arguing that AI training is ‘fair use’ under American copyright law. Whether or not AI training is fair use is at the centre of dozens of AI lawsuits, including those filed by the music industry

items.title: Udio Fires Back Against Supersized Sony Music Suit, Emphasizing Its Fair Use Defense and Acknowledging ‘That It Acquired Some of Its Training Data by Utilizing YT-DLP’
items.summary: Udio has fired back against Sony Music’s supersized copyright suit – including by doubling down on its fair use argument and by accusing the major of engaging “in anticompetitive activities that extend an unlawful monopoly over the production and commercialization of music.” The AI music platform just recently offered…

items.title: Adult Film Producer Unmasks Prolific ‘John Doe’ Torrent Pirate as Meta Executive
items.summary: A routine John Doe lawsuit could become part of Strike 3 Holdings' $446 million AI training case against Meta. The adult film producer wants to link the two lawsuits, arguing that a Reality Labs executive downloaded nearly 20,000 files at his home for work purposes, not for personal use. Meta counters that the alleged…

items.title: Donald Trump’s administration just sided with OpenAI in a key ‘fair use’ case. Here’s what it means for music’s fight with Anthropic and Suno.
items.summary: It appears to be the first time Washington has intervened in any of the copyright cases now stacked up against AI companies Source

items.title: Universal, Sony y Warner invierten en Stability AI
items.summary: Las tres grandes compañías musicales acaban de tomar participación en Stability AI: Universal Music Group, Sony Music Group y Warner Music Group se han sumado a una ronda de inversión de Serie B de 76 millones de dólares en la empresa de inteligencia artificial generativa. Con el movimiento, las majors combinan sus dos…

items.title: Suno pulls unapproved Mary J. Blige ad campaign citing deception
items.summary: Waking up to find that Mary J. Blige appearing in an ad for AI-music platform Suno is quite the eye-opener. Waking up to find that said campaign has already been pulled because she hadn’t approved it… well, let’s just say our eyes are currently on springs like a classic Tex Avery cartoon character. The post is from Mus…

items.title: Canada’s Socan files latest music-industry lawsuit against Suno
items.summary: Suno’s legal team are certainly having a busy week. Hot on the heels of the lawsuit filed by four US-based artists against the company comes another legal action – this one from Canadian collecting society Socan. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Metadata incompleta es dinero que se queda en el limbo
tip.body: ISRC, ISWC, nombres legales completos y porcentajes correctos determinan a quién le pagan. Un solo campo mal escrito manda tus regalías a la bolsa de no identificados.

en.title: Copyright & Artificial Intelligence News
en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: “A Cute Little LibGen Babysitter”: Music Publishers Sue Anthropic Founders Over Torrenting Spree
items.summary: Anthropic and its co‑founders are being sued by Sony Music, Warner Chappell and other major publishers for torrenting pirated books from LibGen and Pirate Library Mirror, alleging that the same activity that led to a $1.5 billion settlement also infringed the publishers’ musical works.

tip.title: Incomplete metadata means money left unclaimed
tip.body: ISRC, ISWC, full legal names and correct splits decide who gets paid. A single mistyped field sends your royalties into the unidentified pool.
